request: Add a function that creates a signed JWT access token with expiry from the configured minutes setting, for the login endpoints.

summary.result_text:
I added `create_access_token` to `lnbits/helpers.py`, but I couldn't run any tests. The test commands needed an approval I didn't get, so none of this has been run.

**What it does:**
- It signs the claims you pass in with `settings.auth_secret_key` using HS256 and adds an `exp` claim.
- The expiry is `token_expire_minutes` if you pass it. Otherwise it uses `settings.auth_token_expire_minutes`, which defaults to 525600 (one year).
- It drops claims whose value is `None`. The existing test in `tests/unit/test_helpers.py` relies on this: it expects `usr` to be absent when it is `None`.

The function was already imported and called in the login endpoints in `lnbits/core/views/auth_api.py`, and in several tests. It just wasn't defined anywhere, so those imports would have failed. Adding the definition is the only change, so the login endpoints needed no edits.

**To verify,** run `make test-unit`, or just `tests/unit/test_helpers.py`, which has `test_access_token_and_internal_message_helpers`. `tests/api/test_auth.py` also exercises it.

I didn't run `make check`.
